executive_summary: Maven compilation failed with 87 errors across multiple files. The root cause is missing Lombok annotations (@Builder, @Data, @Getter, @Setter) on entity and DTO classes, causing builder() methods and getter/setter methods to be unavailable. Additionally, there is a duplicate constructor definition and a missing abstract method implementation.

errors.root_cause: Duplicate constructor definition in ColumnNotFoundException class. The constructor with String parameter is defined twice.
errors.fix_recommendation: Remove one of the duplicate constructor definitions in ColumnNotFoundException.java at line 9. Keep only one constructor that accepts a String parameter.

errors.root_cause: ErrorResponse class is missing @Builder annotation from Lombok, causing builder() method to be unavailable. This affects 6 locations in GlobalExceptionHandler.java.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Builder and @Data annotations to ErrorResponse.java class. Ensure lombok dependency is present in pom.xml and annotation processing is enabled.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: methods getId(), setId(), getStatus(), setStatus(), getUserId(), getCreatedAt(), setCreatedAt(), etc.
errors.root_cause: Task entity class is missing @Data or @Getter/@Setter annotations from Lombok. This causes 50+ compilation errors across InMemoryTaskDataStore, TaskDataStoreImpl, and TaskServiceImpl where these methods are called.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Data annotation (or @Getter and @Setter) to Task.java entity class. Also add @Builder annotation to enable builder pattern usage in TaskServiceImpl.

errors.message: InMemoryTaskDataStore is not abstract and does not override abstract method countByColumnId(String)
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore implements TaskDataStore interface but does not implement the required abstract method countByColumnId(String).
errors.fix_recommendation: Add the missing countByColumnId(String columnId) method implementation in InMemoryTaskDataStore.java. The method should count and return the number of tasks associated with the given columnId.

errors.root_cause: ColumnTaskCountResponse DTO is missing @Builder annotation, causing builder() method to be unavailable in ColumnServiceImpl.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Builder and @Data annotations to ColumnTaskCountResponse.java class.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: methods getStatus(), getColumnId()
errors.root_cause: TaskStatusUpdateRequest DTO is missing @Data or @Getter annotation, causing getter methods to be unavailable in TaskServiceImpl.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Data annotation to TaskStatusUpdateRequest.java class to generate getter methods.

errors.root_cause: TaskStatusUpdateResponse DTO is missing @Builder annotation, causing builder() method to be unavailable in TaskServiceImpl.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Builder and @Data annotations to TaskStatusUpdateResponse.java class.

errors.file: Multiple DTO classes (TaskDetailsResponse, TaskSummary, ValidateTaskMoveRequest, ValidateTaskMoveResponse, TaskCreateRequest, TaskUpdateRequest, PagedTaskResponse, TaskCountResponse, BulkTaskResponse, TaskResponse)
errors.message: cannot find symbol: method builder() or getter/setter methods

errors.fix_recommendation: Add @Builder and @Data annotations to all DTO classes: TaskDetailsResponse, TaskSummary, ValidateTaskMoveRequest, ValidateTaskMoveResponse, TaskCreateRequest, TaskUpdateRequest, PagedTaskResponse, TaskCountResponse, BulkTaskResponse, and TaskResponse. Verify lombok dependency is correctly configured in pom.xml.
